text:
maria: Heads-up — I pushed a WIP for the per-route cost insights panel to the staging dashboard. Looking for quick UX + calc correctness checks.
kevin: ack, can you share the link?
maria: https://staging.redwood/dashboard/costs?view=per-route — shows tokens, cache savings, per-model/unit cost (w/ 95% CI). Thoughts on UI density?
jamal: quick skim — love the per-model unit breakdown. concern: cache savings calc seems to double count prefix hits when there's a reroute. example: route A writes prefix, traffic reroutes to model B in route C, savings attributed to C instead of A.
sophie: Could you paste the agg SQL? I want to sanity check joins.
maria: pasted SQL snippet:
```sql
SELECT route, model, sum(tokens) as tokens,
  sum(case when cache_hit then tokens else 0 end) as cache_tokens,
  sum(cost_per_token * tokens) as raw_cost,
  sum(cost_per_token * (tokens - cache_tokens)) as billable_cost
FROM token_events
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
kevin: billable_cost has tokens - cache_tokens per group, but cache_tokens is aggregated per (route, model) same group — if a request reroutes to a smaller model you'll undercount. needs per-request granularity.
andrew: agree. we should compute per-request token and final_model_used then aggregate. basically: 
```sql
SELECT request_id, final_model, tokens, cache_hit
FROM request_events
JOIN final_assignments USING (request_id)
```
then aggregate.
jamal: also we should attribute cost of prefix cache to original route that wrote it, not the route that read it. Otherwise a canary can parasitically consume savings from stable routes.
sophie: UX question: do we show cache savings as absolute $ or percentage of billable? Both? I lean both + tooltip.
maria: good point on attribution. proposal: add "origin_route" column to cache_writes table and use it when computing cache savings attribution.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: :rocket: staging dashboard updated at 2024-10-26T14:12:03Z
kevin: environment nit: we're using gpt-medium pricing model_id mapping in the UI. need to show both model alias and hardware/quant profile in tooltip.
andrew: small perf ask: make per-route time series lazy-load when user opens route detail. rendering 200 routes kills the browser.
maria: noted. follow-ups: I'll update SQL to per-request, add origin_route attribution, adjust widget for both $ & %. PR incoming to eng-platform repo.
sophie: thanks — will review PR. also can we add a small chart showing unit cost variance by seq_len bucket? helps explain outliers.
maria: yes — adding seq_len histogram.
kevin: lgtm. :thumbsup:
